result.title: Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation
result.comment: The paper was accepted in ICAIF Conference 2026 and presented in Milan, Italy
result.summary: Financial documents combine narrative disclosures, accounting metrics, corporate structures, management commentary, and time-dependent facts, making them difficult to represent using conventional chunk-based retrieval-augmented generation systems. This paper presents an auditable, schema-driven methodology for constructing temporal financial knowledge graphs from page-delimited documents parsed using a general purpose document intelligence service. Overlapping document windows undergo phased large language model extraction of structural entities, quantitative observations, and domain-specific relationships. Candidate graph elements are validated against predefined schemas and consolidated through scope-aware exact, normalized, fuzzy, embedding-based, and LLM-assisted entity resolution. Temporal merge constraints, deterministic edge deduplication, conflict-aware property management, and fine-grained provenance preserve issuer identity, reporting-period validity, and traceability to source evidence. The contributions of this work comprise the proposed methodology for financial knowledge graph construction, the creation of an evidence-grounded temporal knowledge graph from heterogeneous financial documents, and an intrinsic framework for evaluating the quality of the resulting graph. The evaluation framework assesses seven weighted dimensions, two hard validation gates, and structural diagnostics. By separating graph-quality assessment from downstream retrieval and answer generation, the framework supports systematic diagnosis and iterative refinement of the constructed graph.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 schema 驱动的流程，用 LLM 分阶段从金融文档抽取实体、量化观察与关系，经实体归并和时间约束构建带来源信息的知识图谱，并给出与下游检索解耦的内在质量评估框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「独立于下游任务的内在质量评估」与细粒度 provenance、冲突属性管理等思路，可能为 latent 推理状态的可审计性与视觉证据溯源筛选提供评价类比，但仅为概念层面线索，可迁移性需核查。
